cases.name: Michelle Ranea Osborne
cases.about: Michelle was homeless and vulnerable. She lived in Janesville, Wisconsin, before moving to the Middle Keys, according to the sheriff’s office. She had worked as a substance abuse treatment center manager in Janesville, according to records.
cases.narrative: He allegedly raped and strangled her with a ligature.
